tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add an available catalog item to the active shopping cart with optional modifier selections. Returns the updated cart line items, total item count, and recalculated subtotal.

cartId.description: Optional unique cart session ID. If omitted, uses active session cart.

itemId.description: The unique ID of the item from wetaego_search_catalog.

optionIds.description: Selected option IDs within the group

modifiers.description: Selected modifier groups and option IDs.

notes.description: Special preparation instructions or customer preferences.

clearExisting.description: Clear existing cart items before adding, ensuring clean cross-venue isolation.

tools.name: apply_coupon
tools.description: Apply a promotional coupon code or discount voucher to the active shopping cart session. Validates the code, recalculates discounts, and updates the cart subtotal and final total.

couponCode.description: The promotional discount or coupon code to apply (e.g. SAVE10, WELCOME20, PACY50, VIP15, SUMMER20).

cartId.description: Optional cart session identifier. If omitted, applies to the active session cart.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Initialize a new shopping cart session or retrieve the existing active cart. Returns a structured "cartId" (e.g. "cart_demo_abc123") that can be passed to subsequent cart and checkout calls.

tableIdentifier.description: Optional table number, room, seat, or pickup counter.

tools.name: find_venue
tools.description: Search and discover distinct external merchant venues or branch locations across the WETAEGO network. Use "query" for keyword/city search, "name" for exact business matching, or "slug" for direct venue URL lookup. (To switch tabs or departments inside the current venue, use wetaego_open_business_page instead.)

query.description: Free-text keyword or location search (e.g. "Lagos sushi", "spa Lekki").

name.description: Exact or partial business name (e.g. "Pacy Group", "Emerald Cafe").

industry.description: Non-overlapping industry vertical filter: "dining" (restaurants, cafes, bars), "hospitality" (hotels, stays, resorts), "wellness" (spas, salons, beauty), "retail" (boutiques, electronics, supermarkets), "services" (repairs, consulting), "creator" (media, studios, rate cards).

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Return the current cart contents, line items, validated unit prices, modifiers, discount breakdown, applied taxes, and authoritative final total.

cartId.description: Optional unique cart session ID to inspect. If omitted, returns active session cart.

tools.name: get_item_details
tools.description: Return authoritative details for a specific catalog item using its unique itemId, including price, stock status, customizable modifier groups, dietary tags, and variant options.

itemId.description: The unique itemId from wetaego_search_catalog results.

tools.name: initiate_checkout
tools.description: Validate the current cart and generate a locked checkout session with computed taxes, fulfillment options, and totals. Locks prices for 15 minutes. Does NOT charge the customer — call wetaego_submit_order with customer confirmation to finalize.

cartId.description: Optional cart session ID to checkout. If omitted, uses active session cart.

tableIdentifier.description: Table number, room, seat, or pickup counter.

couponCode.description: Optional promotional coupon or discount voucher code to apply before price locking.

phone.description: Customer contact phone number in standard international E.164 format (e.g. +12025550123 or +2348012345678).

tools.name: open_business_page
tools.description: Switch the active storefront viewport to an internal department or category catalog tab (such as "restaurant", "pacy-wellness", "pacy-boutique", "pacy-gadgets", "pacy-stays", "pacy-hotels", "pacy-repairs", "pacy-media") inside the current merchant venue. (To search for other businesses or branches, use wetaego_find_venue.)

conceptSlug.description: The standardized kebab-case URL slug of the internal department or concept to open (e.g. "restaurant", "pacy-wellness", "pacy-boutique", "pacy-gadgets", "pacy-stays", "pacy-hotels", "pacy-repairs", "pacy-media").

venueSlug.description: Optional venue slug (e.g. "demo", "emerald-cafe", "ocean-ember", "lotus-spa"). If omitted, uses active venue.

tools.name: recommend_pairings
tools.description: Suggest complementary catalog items, sides, drinks, or accessories. If itemId is omitted, recommendations are generated based on the active cart items or top venue specialties; if itemId is provided, recommendations specifically complement that item.

itemId.description: Optional focal item ID. If omitted, pairings are selected from current cart items or venue favorites.

tools.name: request_staff
tools.description: Send an immediate service or waiter call notification to venue floor staff for a specific table or room.

reason.description: Structured reason for requesting staff assistance.

tableIdentifier.description: Table number, room, or seat requesting assistance.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search catalog items, products, dishes, and services with category and price filters. Returns item details, prices, and availability.

query.description: Keyword search query for products, dishes, or services.

venueSlug.description: Optional venue slug (e.g. "demo", "emerald-cafe", "ocean-ember", "lotus-spa") to scope search to a specific merchant.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO 4217 target currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, NGN) for dynamic rate conversion.

dietary.description: Dietary classification filters for food & dining.

maxPrice.description: Maximum price filter in major currency units.

inStockOnly.description: Return only in-stock or available items.

tools.name: submit_order
tools.description: Submit a prepared checkout session as an authoritative live customer order. Requires authorization.confirmed: true indicating the customer reviewed and approved the order total.

confirmed.description: Set to true after the customer confirms the order total.

confirmationId.description: Optional confirmation tracking token or receipt reference.

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Modify the quantity of an existing line item in the cart or remove it completely by setting quantity to 0.

cartId.description: Optional unique cart session ID. If omitted, updates active cart.

lineId.description: The unique lineId of the item to update.

quantity.description: New quantity. Set to 0 to remove item.
